notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). Paste a prose passage and press Read to score it against 12 emotions. You get a whole-text fingerprint strip, a colour palette, a ranked breakdown with the dominant emotion, a per-sentence emotional arc chart, and the text re-rendered with emotion shading and highlighted keywords. Data used in the run: example. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
